contract:
Contract SubmitLoanRequestModule::calculateScore(): Integer {
	precondition:
		let currentLoanRequest: LoanRequest = self.CurrentLoanRequest in
		if currentLoanRequest.oclIsUndefined() = false 
		then let requestedCAHistory: CheckingAccount = currentLoanRequest.RequestedCAHistory,requestedCreditHistory: CreditHistory = currentLoanRequest.RequestedCreditHistory in
		requestedCAHistory.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		requestedCreditHistory.oclIsUndefined() = false 
		else false 
		endif 
	postcondition:
		self.CurrentLoanRequest.CreditScore = 100 and
		self.CurrentLoanRequest.Status = LoanRequestStatus::SUBMITTED and
		result = 100
}
